summary: Strangler reverse proxy :9000 with token-gated flip
prompt: Read docs/SPEC.md first; it is the binding contract. Use only the project venv (.venv/bin/python, .venv/bin/pytest); do not install new packages and do not modify files under tests/ or docs/. Keep code clean, typed, documented, and production quality. Do not touch .switch-infra/ or .native/. Implement SPEC §6: targets/proxy/router.py — an ASGI app (Starlette is available via fastapi; or plain ASGI) served by uvicorn when run as `python -m targets.proxy.router --port N` (argparse --port default 9000, --host default 127.0.0.1). Read env LEGACY_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:9001), MODERN_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:9002), ROUTER_STATE_FILE (default <repo>/.state/router.json; create parent dirs), ROUTER_ADMIN_TOKEN (default strangler-local-token). Re-read the state file on each request is NOT required; keep state in memory and write it atomically on flip; load it at startup. Use one shared httpx.AsyncClient (timeout 30s, no redirects followed) created in lifespan. Forward method, path, raw query string, body, headers minus hop-by-hop and host; return upstream status, body and headers minus hop-by-hop/content-length/content-encoding, plus X-Strangler-Upstream. tests/fake_upstream.py is the test upstream.
